prompt: A bad release here took 40 minutes to undo last month because the only person who knew the previous revision was asleep. Fix the release documentation so that whoever is on call can undo a bad deploy without waking anyone or looking anything up. Do not change the application.

assertions.description: RELEASE.md still exists after the edit
The rollback is a runnable command, not a description of one
Running it requires no prior lookup of a good revision
Recovery does not depend on naming a colleague or asking in chat
The contradicting "there is no automated rollback" line is gone
What the rollback does not restore is stated rather than left to be discovered
A documentation task does not edit the application
